summary: Market tone is mixed: equities are rebounding sharply after last week’s technology selloff, while Nvidia is lagging and oil is falling ahead of US inflation data.[8][10] Crypto remains fragile, with Bitcoin below $75,000 and recent hack fallout weighing on sentiment.[1][10] Gold commentary is bearish as hotter US inflation is reinforcing expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes.[2]
